sub_fields.label: Scroller Variant
sub_fields.name: scroller_variant
sub_fields.instructions: Choose which visual layout to render for this image scroller.

sub_fields.label: Uniform Item Size
sub_fields.name: uniform_item_size
sub_fields.instructions: Keep a single width and height for all images. Disable to use per-item width and height overrides.

sub_fields.label: Show Captions
sub_fields.name: show_captions
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle caption display under each image.

sub_fields.label: Caption Font Family
sub_fields.name: caption_font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Typography control for image captions.

sub_fields.label: Caption Font Weight
sub_fields.name: caption_font_weight
sub_fields.instructions: Weight for image captions.

sub_fields.label: Image Height
sub_fields.name: scroller_image_height
sub_fields.instructions: Set the visible height of the scroller images, such as 220px or 18rem.

sub_fields.label: Image Ratio
sub_fields.name: scroller_image_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Optional ratio for scroller images, such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, or 16:9. Leave blank to keep the default width.

sub_fields.label: Image Gap
sub_fields.name: scroller_image_gap
sub_fields.instructions: Base gap fallback when row and column gaps are not set.

sub_fields.label: Row Gap
sub_fields.name: scroller_row_gap
sub_fields.instructions: Optional vertical gap between rows (used by masonry row spacing).

sub_fields.label: Column Gap
sub_fields.name: scroller_column_gap
sub_fields.instructions: Optional horizontal gap between scroller items/groups.

sub_fields.label: Masonry Row 2 Offset
sub_fields.name: masonry_row_offset
sub_fields.instructions: Horizontal offset for masonry row 2 (for example 120px) so top and bottom rows do not align into rigid columns.

sub_fields.label: Item Width Override
sub_fields.name: item_width
sub_fields.instructions: Optional per-item width (example: 470px or 28vw). Used when uniform sizing is off.

sub_fields.label: Item Height Override
sub_fields.name: item_height
sub_fields.instructions: Optional per-item height (example: 300px). Used when uniform sizing is off.

sub_fields.label: Section Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_anchor_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional in-page anchor for linking directly to this section.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: section_eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Optional small label above the FAQ heading.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Text Transform
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_text_transform
sub_fields.instructions: Choose how the eyebrow text should be cased.

sub_fields.label: Section Heading
sub_fields.name: section_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Allows light inline markup such as <strong>, <em>, and <br>.

sub_fields.label: Intro Copy
sub_fields.name: section_intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional intro text above the categories and accordion groups.

sub_fields.label: Categories Heading
sub_fields.name: categories_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Shown above the category jump links when there is more than one FAQ group.

sub_fields.label: Categories Supporting Copy
sub_fields.name: categories_intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional copy under the category links, for example the contact email line.

sub_fields.label: FAQ Groups
sub_fields.name: faq_groups
sub_fields.instructions: Add one or more FAQ categories, each with its own list of questions and answers.

sub_fields.label: Group Title
sub_fields.name: faq_section
sub_fields.instructions: Examples: Reservation & Arrival, Guest Rooms, Dining at the Lodge.

sub_fields.label: Group Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: faq_section_anchor_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional in-page anchor for this FAQ group.

sub_fields.label: Group Summary
sub_fields.name: faq_section_summary
sub_fields.instructions: Short descriptive line shown in the category jump list under the group title.
sub_fields.placeholder: Brief summary of the questions this group answers.

sub_fields.label: Include in Category Block
sub_fields.name: include_in_category_block
sub_fields.instructions: When enabled, this group will appear in the category jump list at the top of the accordion section. Enable for primary category groupings.
sub_fields.message: Show this category in the jump list

sub_fields.label: Section Heading Font Face
sub_fields.name: heading_font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the typeface for the main section heading.

sub_fields.label: Accordion Question Font Face
sub_fields.name: accordion_heading_font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the typeface for the question headings. Freight Big Pro is the more readable default for this component.

sub_fields.label: Content Alignment
sub_fields.name: content_alignment
sub_fields.instructions: Controls the alignment of the section header and supporting copy.

sub_fields.label: Container Width
sub_fields.name: container_type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose whether the section uses the standard centered container or full-width container shell.

sub_fields.label: FAQ Desktop Frame Width (%)
sub_fields.name: content_frame_width
sub_fields.instructions: Set a percentage width for the FAQ content frame on desktop. Recommended range: 48% to 65%.

sub_fields.label: Additional Section Classes
sub_fields.name: section_classes
sub_fields.instructions: Optional extra classes for one-off layout tweaks.

sub_fields.label: Section Keyline
sub_fields.name: section_keyline_position
sub_fields.instructions: Optional 1px divider line for the top or bottom of the section.

sub_fields.label: Keyline Color
sub_fields.name: section_keyline_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional color for the section keyline and accordion dividers.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: section_eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small label above heading (optional).

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_anchor_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Used for page hash links (no # prefix).

sub_fields.label: Image Position
sub_fields.name: image_position
sub_fields.instructions: Flips which side the collage panel sits on. Content column moves to the opposite side automatically.

sub_fields.label: Collage Variant
sub_fields.name: collage_variant
sub_fields.instructions: Overlap Trio layers frames with overlapping edges for a dynamic stacked look. Portrait + Stack uses a tall portrait frame with two smaller frames stacked beside it.

sub_fields.label: Collage Layout Recipe
sub_fields.name: collage_preset
sub_fields.instructions: Picks a preset arrangement by image count and layout variant. The number before the dash is the image count — make sure it matches how many image rows you add below. The letter (a/b/c) selects a different overlap arrangement for that count. Leave as Auto to use Option A for your image count.

choices.auto: Auto (Option A for selected image count)

sub_fields.label: Media Min Height
sub_fields.name: media_min_height
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the minimum height of the entire collage stage. Increase to give images more vertical room. Use a px value for a fixed floor (e.g. 680px) or clamp() for responsive scaling. Default: clamp(460px, 52vw, 760px).

sub_fields.label: Collage Images
sub_fields.name: collage_items
sub_fields.instructions: Add one row per collage image (max 6). The Layout Recipe above controls default positions — leave per-image override fields blank to use those defaults. Only fill in overrides when you need to adjust a specific frame's crop, size, or position.

sub_fields.label: Grid Column
sub_fields.name: grid_column
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the horizontal span within the 12-column collage grid. Format: start / span width. Example: 1 / span 8 starts at column 1 and spans 8 of 12 columns (~67% width). Larger span = wider frame. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Grid Row
sub_fields.name: grid_row
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the vertical span within the 12-row collage grid. Format: start / span height. Example: 3 / span 9 starts at row 3 and extends 9 rows tall. Smaller span = shorter frame. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Offset X
sub_fields.name: offset_x
sub_fields.instructions: Nudges the frame horizontally outside the grid cell to create the overlap effect. Negative = left, positive = right. Small steps (4–14px) create the characteristic overlapping look. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Offset Y
sub_fields.name: offset_y
sub_fields.instructions: Nudges the frame vertically. Small negative values (-4px to -12px) create a natural vertical stagger between frames. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Layer Order
sub_fields.name: z_index
sub_fields.instructions: Controls which images appear in front when frames overlap. Higher number = in front. Example: frame with 5 appears over a frame with 2. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Image Focus (object-position)
sub_fields.name: object_position
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the crop focal point. Format: horizontal% vertical%. 50% 50% = center. 50% 20% shifts the crop toward the top (good for faces near the top of the frame). Adjust only when the default crop cuts off a key subject. Leave blank to use the recipe default.

sub_fields.label: Background Gradient
sub_fields.name: background_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Optional CSS gradient for the section background, such as linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(36,49,39,0.92) 0%, rgba(27,36,29,0.92) 100%).

sub_fields.label: Background Vertical Position
sub_fields.name: background_vertical_position
sub_fields.instructions: Optional vertical position for the background image, such as top, center, bottom, or 30%.

sub_fields.label: Enable Background Parallax
sub_fields.name: background_parallax
sub_fields.instructions: Uses fixed background attachment for a simple parallax effect.

sub_fields.label: Scrollwork Color
sub_fields.name: scrollwork_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional color for the scrollwork ornament.

sub_fields.label: Media Mode
sub_fields.name: media_mode
sub_fields.instructions: Single image for split-banner behavior, or collage for split-collage behavior.

sub_fields.label: Variant
sub_fields.name: split_media_variant
sub_fields.instructions: Standard keeps image+content. Experience List swaps media lane for itemized experiences. About Band prioritizes a single editorial lane.

sub_fields.label: Content Source
sub_fields.name: content_source
sub_fields.instructions: Manual uses section heading/copy fields. Linked article can auto-fill title/excerpt/featured image.

sub_fields.label: Linked Article
sub_fields.name: linked_article
sub_fields.instructions: Pick an article/post to source title, excerpt, image, and permalink from.

sub_fields.label: Seam Gutter Width
sub_fields.name: seam_gutter_width
sub_fields.instructions: Optional CSS width for the center seam gutter when the ornament renders between the two lanes. Leave blank to keep the component default.

sub_fields.label: Single Image
sub_fields.name: section_image
sub_fields.instructions: Used for single-image mode; can override linked article featured image when set.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: section_eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small label above heading (optional).

sub_fields.label: Heading / Override Title
sub_fields.name: section_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Manual mode: section heading. Linked article mode: optional override title (leave blank to use the linked article title).

sub_fields.label: Copy / Override Excerpt
sub_fields.name: section_intro
sub_fields.instructions: Manual mode: section copy. Linked article mode: optional override excerpt (leave blank to use the linked article excerpt).

sub_fields.label: Experience Items
sub_fields.name: experience_items
sub_fields.instructions: Used by the Experience List variant.

sub_fields.label: About Band: Single Lane
sub_fields.name: about_emphasize_single_lane
sub_fields.instructions: Hide the secondary lane and run one full-width editorial lane.

sub_fields.label: About Band Content Width
sub_fields.name: about_content_width
sub_fields.instructions: Desktop content-lane width for About Band. Use a percentage (for example 65%).

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_anchor_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Used for page hash links (no # prefix).

description: Flexible page builder fields for the reusable theme sections.
